description: A bare <h2> with zero author CSS, validating the framework's own default element stylesheet (display/font-size/font-weight/margin) against Chromium's real UA stylesheet, both rendered with the identical embedded Open Sans font.

classification.reason: Chromium's own text rasterizer and Florui's skrifa+tiny-skia one anti-alias and hint the identical font differently at the pixel level, even with matching logical layout - geometry (compare_geometry) is this fixture's precise signal, pixel comparison only a secondary one. Calibrated against a real live Chromium run: this fixture measured under this tightened threshold, comfortably below it (see florui-conformance's tests/compare_reference_fixture.rs for the harness itself).
